# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
1. THE GATE MUST RUN ON A COMMITTED TREE. Its clean-checkout check reads the
   working tree at the end and cannot tell a session's own uncommitted work
   from a suite that wrote into the checkout; it names every modified path as
   if a suite had left it there and refuses to report green. Cost: one full
   434s run reported as 2 SUITES FAILED when only one suite was actually red.
   The order is commit, then gate, then push; a red gate means a new commit or
   an amend, never an uncommitted fix.

2. A WORKTREE AGENT STARTS FROM HEAD, NEVER FROM THE MAIN TREE'S UNCOMMITTED
   STATE. Two agents in a row were briefed against work sitting uncommitted in
   the main tree and both correctly reported the task as impossible; the first
   cost about 110k tokens. What worked: commit the prerequisite as a
   checkpoint first, and NAME THE EXPECTED HEAD SHA IN THE BRIEF with an
   instruction to stop if HEAD is older. The next agent quoted its HEAD back
   and succeeded first time.

3. SPLITTING ONE CHANGE ACROSS SEVERAL SCOPE TASKS MAKES EVERY CLOSE FAIL. The
   diff postcondition reads the whole diff from base, so each task sees its
   siblings' files as outside its own declaration. Three A5 tasks all had to be
   force-closed with the disposition recorded. One task per change, declaring
   every path, is the shape that closes clean; A6 was opened that way.

4. THE TWO ONE-WRITER REGISTRIES CANNOT RECOGNISE EACH OTHER'S OWNER, and this
   session was refused out of its own fence to prove it. The installed
   sbe_fence_hook.same_session prefix-matches the raw harness session id
   against the derived bm1- label bm_store.py writes; neither is a prefix of
   the other, so every BrotherMode claim reads as foreign. Its own docstring
   calls that a false MISS and names it the direction it does not want to fail
   in. Continued under the hook's documented BROTHERSBE_FENCE_SESSION identity
   override, never its off switch. Queued as M13. This is the half M12 did not
   close: M12 taught the assurance side to PARSE a BrotherMode fence line, not
   to recognise who owns one.

5. A BRIEF'S SCOPE LIST IS A CORRECTNESS INPUT, NOT A COURTESY. The A6 brief
   named seven files; a version bump in this repository is a four-manifest
   change plus the runbook. The builder hit six failures it could not fix
   inside its allowlist, refused to widen scope on its own, and returned
   UNFINISHED naming the exact four files. That refusal was correct and saved
   a silent out-of-scope edit. The orchestrator finished the manifests itself
   rather than dispatch again, because a second dispatch would have required
   committing a partial cut, and the version law says the release version name
   appears exactly once, on the release commit.

6. RE-SERIALISING A JSON FILE TO ADD ONE ITEM REWROTE ALL 2588 LINES. Reverted
   and done as a targeted textual append: 13 insertions, 0 deletions.
   json.load plus json.dump is a whole-file rewrite wearing the costume of a
   small edit.

7. THE GATE CAUGHT WHAT NO REVIEWER WOULD HAVE: four new refusal codes shipped
   with no founder-facing rewrite, and a closed registry in test_bm_visual.py
   fails in BOTH directions on that. A new refusal cannot ship speaking only to
   engineers, and a rewrite cannot outlive the code that emits it.

8. VERIFYING A BUILDER'S REFUSALS BY FIRING THEM BY HAND FOUND WHAT A PASSING
   SUITE COULD NOT SAY: every refusal returned a NAMED reason, and the return
   edge was proven by watching bm_idle read the queue back at depth 49 where
   the real queue reads 48. A green suite says the assertions passed; it does
   not say the thing works end to end.

9. THE SMOKE'S SANDBOX HELD, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. The vault records a
   2026-08-16 case where CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR scoped settings but not plugin
   installs. Today both ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json and
   known_marketplaces.json were byte-identical before and after the smoke
   (13c9474a..., 851e6d5c...). The lesson does not reproduce in this flow, and
   the way to know that was to snapshot rather than to trust either way.

10. WebFetch of a 50KB artifact returns the whole page into context. Publishing
    to an existing artifact URL from a session that has not viewed the current
    version requires that fetch first. Budget for it, or publish from the
    session that last published.
